<description>
The help text didn't show how to use `max-connections` with the default Unix socket.

This change adds a `unix:,max-connections=8` example and explains that the colon is required.

Tested:
- `bitcoin-node -help` shows the updated text.
- Tested on regtest and confirmed that the default socket gets 8 connection slots.

Fixes #36657
</description>
